name: impact-reg
desc: Multimodal pairwise image registration via impact-reg-konfai (FireANTs SyN, ConvexAdam, or elastix rigid+BSpline presets from the VBoussot/ImpactReg Hugging Face repo). Accepts NIfTI or OME-Zarr fixed/moving volumes (and optional masks) directly. Runs with or without a GPU: falls back to CPU automatically unless require_cuda is set.

engine.desc: Registration engine/preset: fireants (FireANTs_SyN, GPU-capable diffeomorphic SyN), convexadam (ConvexAdam_Composite, MIND features), or elastix (Generic_Rigid_BSpline).

preset_override.desc: Exact preset app name from the VBoussot/ImpactReg Hugging Face repo (e.g. FireANTs_Affine, ConvexAdam_Coarse, MR_CT_TS), overriding the engine mapping. Empty uses the engine's default preset.

gpu.desc: Use a GPU if one is visible to torch. Disable to force CPU even when a GPU is present.

require_cuda.desc: Fail instead of silently falling back to CPU when no GPU is visible.

fields_only.desc: Write the displacement field only; skip computing the moved image.

extra_set.desc: Comma-separated NAME=VALUE pairs, each forwarded as a separate --set to impact-reg-konfai (e.g. to tune iterations or patch size). Empty means none.

inputs.desc: Fixed/reference volume as NIfTI (alternative to fixed_ome_zarr).
Fixed/reference volume as an OME-Zarr store (alternative to fixed_nifti).
Moving volume as NIfTI (alternative to moving_ome_zarr).
Moving volume as an OME-Zarr store (alternative to moving_nifti).
Optional fixed-space mask restricting the metric region, as NIfTI (alternative to fixed_mask_ome_zarr). Whole-image mask used if none given.
Optional fixed-space mask as an OME-Zarr store (alternative to fixed_mask_nifti).
Optional moving-space mask, as NIfTI (alternative to moving_mask_ome_zarr). Whole-image mask used if none given.
Optional moving-space mask as an OME-Zarr store (alternative to moving_mask_nifti).

outputs.desc: Displacement field (moving -> fixed) as a NIfTI vector image, plus the moved image and the raw ITK Transform.h5 as extra files.
